description:

title: Flywheel adoption review hardening round
description:
Outcome: fresh-eyes review of this adoption diff; findings logged in docs/plans/flywheel-adopts-dicklesworthstone_meta_operator/reviews.jsonl (one JSON object per line with resolved flag) until zero unresolved.

- Test suite green: the repo pytest gate (>=90% branch coverage).

Future-self context: reviews-clean gate reads exactly that reviews.jsonl path.

title: OPS-4 incremental upstream verify
description:
Outcome: OPS-4 incremental upstream verify: stage 30 (scripts/30_verify_upstream.py) caches per-repo origin tip state (sha of origin/<default> recorded in the previous artifact); unchanged tips skip the expensive re-verify and report a cache hit; moved tips always re-verify.

Acceptance criteria (binary):
- Second consecutive run reports cache hits and measurably less wall-clock (print the counts).
- A repo whose upstream moved between runs is always re-verified (mutation test).
- Artifact schema stays backward compatible (old upstream_status.json still loads).

Future-self context: pure-local design (OPS-4 smart fetch already does offline passes); no new network budget. Tests zero-mock with tmp fixture repos.

title: Corpus-scale cma integration lane and dashboard panel
description:
Outcome: joint functionality with code_meta_analysis: a new orchestration lane that runs cma analysis over corpus repos (or a --limit subset) and surfaces the per-repo reports in the dashboard (stage 60 gains a cma panel: issues count, dependency-graph centrality, lane status per repo).

Acceptance criteria (binary):
- `uv run python scripts/50_orchestrate.py --auto cma-analyze --limit 3` invokes cma lanes CLI (scripts/lanes.py in the code_meta_analysis checkout, resolved via config, default path ../code_meta_analysis) and records per-repo results in the runs artifact.
- Stage 60 renders the cma panel; a repo without a cma report shows "no cma report yet".
- Failure isolation: a repo where cma fails is a failed row in the runs artifact, never a pipeline abort.

Future-self context: cma is the analyzer (do not reimplement lanes here); the integration is orchestration + surfacing only. cma corpus-mode bead cma-xa9 lands the driver this lane can target at scale; until then drive cma per-repo.

title: Reconcile OPS backlog truth (run acceptance commands, close delivered rows)
description:
Outcome: the TODO backlog tells the truth: OPS-1..OPS-3 were delivered 2026-09-03 (v0.2.0) but their TODO rows still read "open". Run each delivered row's acceptance command and negative control, then mark the rows done with delivery notes; any acceptance command that fails becomes a real fix in this round, not a TODO edit.

Acceptance criteria (binary):
- OPS-1: `uv run python scripts/90_sync_corpus.py` (or a scoped variant if the full run is too long) exits 0 and stage 30 reports the corpus consistent.
- OPS-2: `uv run python scripts/50_orchestrate.py --help` shows --include-forks/--no-forks; a scoped run proves exclusion.
- OPS-3: a repo with .gitmodules exercises the submodule path or the code path is covered by a test.
- TODO.md rows updated in place; no row marked done without its acceptance command passing in the same source revision.

Future-self context: TODO.md is the single canonical status surface (repo AGENTS.md); the operator task board mirrors the flywheel view, not OPS bookkeeping.
